response.query: How should we design and pretest performance-based digital-literacy items and trace-data tasks, and assess/remediate differential item functioning across SES and language groups?
response.answer: Design performance-based digital-literacy items with clear objectives and pilot them with diverse SES and language groups. Use statistical methods to assess differential item functioning and adjust accordingly. Remediate identified disparities through targeted interventions.
